q1.sampleAnswer: Because his mother was not home.

examples: his mother was on a business trip

q1.explanationZh: 第二段说妈妈三天前出差了，生日这天只有爸爸在家，作者很想妈妈，所以难过。

evidence.quote: My mother left home three days before on a business trip

q2.explanationZh: 第二段作者心里想的是希望妈妈能回家，这就是他最大的生日愿望。

evidence.quote: I wish that mummy could come back home

q3.sampleAnswer: He was cleaning the messy room.
q3.rubricZh: 要点：在打扫凌乱的房间。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说朋友们走后，爸爸正在收拾凌乱的房间。

evidence.quote: My father was cleaning the messy room.

q4.explanationZh: 第四段说开门后是妈妈，最后一句说“她就是我的生日礼物”。

q5.sampleAnswer: His mother returned from her business trip early as a surprise.

keyPoints.descZh: 妈妈提前结束出差回家
examples: His mother returned from her business trip early

q5.rubricZh: 要点：妈妈提前结束出差回家，给了作者惊喜。
q5.explanationZh: 文中的“意外的喜悦”就是妈妈在出差结束前回家，让作者特别惊喜。

evidence.quote: I didn’t expect that my mother would come home before the business trip ended.

q6.sampleAnswer: Hearing my favourite song on the radio is a small surprise for me. It will brighten my day.

keyPoints.descZh: 说出一件合理的、小而意外的开心事
examples: hearing my favourite song on the radio

q6.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：写出一件小而意外、能让一天变好的事。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题，没有唯一答案。写一件生活中小小的意外好事，比如听到喜欢的歌，再说说它让你心情变好。

evidence.quote: Have you ever had similar amazing moments of unexpected joy in your life?
